new_today_news.headline: Restaurant job growth uneven across states; Full-service segment added 97,000 jobs between March 2025 and March 2026
new_today_news.summary: Full-service restaurant employment remains 193,000 jobs below pre-pandemic levels as of March 2026, though the segment added 97,000 net jobs in the past year. Meanwhile, limited-service employment stands above pre-pandemic readings, with snack and nonalcoholic beverage bars up 25% and quick-service restaurants up 1.6%.

recent_news.headline: The 6 Biggest Chain Restaurant Closures Of 2026 So Far
recent_news.summary: Wendy's is closing around 300 stores in 2026, with Smokey Bones completing all closures as of April 28, 2026. Bahama Breeze closed 14 locations (half its footprint) in April, and other chains including Peet's Coffee are reducing their physical locations.
